items: 3 juicy dates if they are hard microwave them for 30 seconds
1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste (or sub vanilla extract)

steps: Add all ingredients to a blender and blend on high until smooth. This takes about 2 minutes. I scraped down the sides a few times.
Pour pudding into a glass jar or bowl. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.
Eat with your favorite toppings, I went with cacao nibs and flaky salt.
